commit.message:
research: verify new-only native angular source adapter on pinned REI owner

Compile the unchanged 57-file REI owner and apply P2/P4 weights only to a newly injected explicitly isotropic birth increment. Preserve existing anisotropic radiation and owner spectral/bin semantics through transactional addition. Record seven native tests, twenty measurements, six runner regressions, source/binary identities and independent adapter review.

Separate native transfer ledger and fixed-birth shear tangent checks from the remaining spectral discrepancy, finite-d continuum accuracy, source histories and Einstein feedback. Update DAG and copyable continuation handoffs; no production default or checkpoint changes.

## S2 execution and S3 P4-response checkpoint — 2026-10-19

S2 commit `87149cdb673c250ccbb36dda5d43a38f0f7dd7b7` executes the five previously authored `balance.rs` tests on unchanged source: **5 PASS**. The original Python15 and PR173 native58/negative5 are reused evidence, not rerun.

S3 commit `a7938ad51ad0fa324c5cb680dddb5fbfc7ed218e`, tree `0ec77ae9245c3e9c6380456645d2bee5d47c5abc`, publishes the new derivation, strict-positive full-rank P2/P4 implementation, frozen-birth campaign and independent review. Fresh Git tree/ref readback matched all74 published blob identities with no unexpected changed path.

Direct differentiation gives `D'(0)=-(8/5)P0-(10/7)P2+(36/35)P4`. Thus for `A=<D>/<R>` with `M2=0`, `A'(0)=-8/5+(36/35)M4`. With `M2=M4=0`, `A''(0)=16/7+(216/77)M6`. Birth isotropy and subsequent shear response are distinct conditions. Positive exact counterexamples and1023 independent rational support checks are included.

Actual new validation: Python S3 **14 PASS**, independent Rust P24 **16 PASS**, CLI **1 valid +7 negative controls PASS**, final recovery-guard **13 PASS**. The165-rule campaign contains146 measured rules/1606 response points and19 explicit support failures. P24 has43 successes,7 mean-support failures and5 upper-hull failures. Same-input Python/Rust agreement on all43 successes has max weight difference `3.3306690738754696e-16`; max Rust moment residual `2.856655884064807e-15` under the unchanged `3e-15` gate.

Two independent-review findings in measurement reuse were fixed and closed: exact grid/source/moment validation, and continuum-cache consistency. Original measurement and report-producer snapshots remain intact. The plot mathtext failure occurred after saving all measurements; only reporting was recovered. One reference roundoff warning remains recorded. No negative weights, support deletion or relaxed moment tolerance was used.

Read `S3_THEORY_KO.md`, `S3_RESULTS_KO.md`, `DAG.json`, `RETURN_TO_CHATGPT.json` and `evidence_s3/INDEPENDENT_PYTHON_REVIEW.json`. Strict rank1 floating-point ambiguity remains explicitly unresolved. Moment matching does not certify continuum angular accuracy, finite-bin spectral accuracy or coupled Einstein evolution.

Create-only S3 backup prepared: `BASS_S3_P24_RESPONSE_20261019_a7938ad5.zip`,554697bytes, SHA256 `7d040f80cc4edee2a32c490938f59c2526c934f543ae64c4acd548bf1b8958d3`,79 manifest payloads. Dual-cloud upload/readback receipts will be posted at closeout; this comment does not claim they have completed. S2 Dropbox object existence was separately confirmed after a stalled status-poll service call.

The fixed-owner native adapter has executed locally (7 new tests,20 measured rows); its source, raw logs and independent review follow in a separate commit. Draft PR, fixed REI spectral owner `0e25846433170d0f420c4cda44a0bedbf02cd177`, existing radiation and physically anisotropic sources remain preserved. No production/full EoR/merge admission.
